extra.message: resetPassword resolves the account to modify via pendingResetOwners keyed by the email local-part (mailboxName). An attacker can register an account whose local-part collides with a victim on a different domain, request their own reset token, then reset the victim's password because the mailbox key now maps to the victim user id. This is an account-takeover flaw (CWE-287).
